scope: Root-authorized generic optional playbackStatus and public album/artist identity persistence, core only; no QQ-specific renderer state.

contract.optionalPlaybackStatus: Track.playbackStatus?: 'unsupported'; omitted status retains existing playback behavior. This describes current source adaptation support, not native type21 capability, deletion or account rights.
contract.visibleMetadata: SongList and StreamingDetailStage keep every metadata row, style/aria-disable unsupported activation, and show 当前音源尚不支持这首歌曲; modifiers may still select rows for non-playback library actions.
contract.queue: Bulk playback and queue insertion preserve supported order/duplicate identities and report skipped count. Store activation/load/target resolution reject unsupported before source authorization/history/audio work.
contract.restoration: Named queue prepare rejects all-unsupported before mode/heart/queue mutation; selects actual filtered queue/index; retains saved position only for same entryId/id/source. Automatic playbackSession restore resolves saved identity on original snapshots, filters unsupported and remaps index; unavailable saved selection starts the first supported entry at position0; all unsupported reports skip notice and leaves current state untouched.
contract.identities: Optional albumId:string and artists:{id?:string|number,name:string}[] retained in shared/renderer/plugin Track, playbackSession clone, compact queue, named queue save/restore and local playlist snapshot. Renderer TrackArtistRef keeps compatible re-export from shared canonical owner.
contract.validation: albumId/string artist id nonempty trimmed, <=8192 UTF16 units, no NUL; artist name <=8192 and no NUL, empty allowed to retain positional unknown artist; <=128 dense artist entries, numeric id safe integer. Invalid fields omitted by clone/save or rejected by savedQueue validator. Clone copies only public name/id and detaches arrays/objects. No source-specific identity parsing or extra native fields.
contract.compatibility: Additive optional fields without queue document version change. Old snapshots missing these fields remain valid; stale stream URLs stay excluded from saved remote queues. No live persistence rewrite/delete.

closedRegressions.evidence: Actual controller regression failed before fix; unsupported rows filtered before queue/current commit with stable saved duplicate identity and position remap; all-blocked preserves state.
